read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Read-only mode applies to every device on this account. Home Assistant keeps the camera stream, sensors and motion and sound detection, but gets no control over device settings: camera power or sleep, night light, volume and Sound & Light controls are removed, and automations that use them stop working. Turning it off brings them back with the same names and entity IDs.
